Book title and physical page queries find labelled source companions.
Search/filter survives opening a result, back navigation and reload.
Selected page tasks receive useful focus at phone widths.

10 original A2 conversation scenes with30 bounded turns.

goals.outcome: Make daily work, grammar continuation and vocabulary follow the active chapter.
acceptance: Started sessions retain their chosen vocabulary bank across content changes and backup reloads.
Level labels and programme counts reflect actual selected material.
Grammar continuation prefers the active programme and available prerequisites.

goals.outcome: Open book citations at the right physical page in individual or combined private PDF exports.
acceptance: SHA-based bundle matching works despite renaming.

Shared object URLs are revoked only after their last connection is released.
PDF bytes and object URLs never enter progress storage or uploads.

goals.outcome: Validate the complete enriched site with synthetic learner state and private-source boundaries.
acceptance: Daily tests, type checking, lint and static build pass.
